Adapt to China

Making a new country feel a little less unfamiliar.

What it is
A live platform for newcomers to China: practical guides, local directories (hospitals, halal and vegetarian food), the ATC AI assistant, a House Planner in testing, and optional paid human support when an answer is not enough.
Who it's for
International students, professionals and people relocating, short-term visitors — and anyone with specific needs such as diet, healthcare access, pets or housing sensitivities.
Problems it solves
  • Everyday services — payments, transport, healthcare, renting — assume you already know the system and read Chinese.
  • Information is scattered across Chinese-language apps and group chats; translation alone does not tell you the next step.
  • Some tasks need a phone call or real coordination, not just an answer — so there is scoped human help.
My role
Founder (since July 2026) · user research · product strategy · content · AI-assisted development · operations

ATC AI

  • Ask about a real situation. Renting, payments, transport, healthcare, Chinese apps — in your own words, or with a screenshot.
  • Two modes. General for everyday questions; House Planner (testing) turns housing needs into a search brief.
  • Thinking & Web Search. Deeper reasoning and a search step for time-sensitive facts.
  • Honest by design. “AI can make mistakes. Check important details.” A person helps when an answer is not enough.
Try ATC AI ↗

What people said

“Recommendations alone are insufficient. People need a sequence of decisions, checks and handoffs — and to know which part is guidance, which is AI, and which is a person.”

Status & limits Live and independently maintained; tools have different readiness levels. House Planner makes a search brief and checklist — it does not fetch listings, reserve homes or guarantee availability. AI answers and directory records need source and date checks; hospital help is navigation, not medical advice. Human services have an agreed scope and price, and decisions and payments stay with the customer. Six paid orders and about RMB 1,000 received (October 2026) are an early signal, not evidence of recurring revenue or scale.
